scope: Approved sequential reference-error/event-evidence development then continuous-effect tuning; EV only, reports excluded

reference_candidate.method: prefix-centered pooled Ridge forecast with historical shape and spline by horizon interactions
reference_candidate.inputs: four15min means in legal[-75,-15]prefix, aligned observed historical mean; no post-notice data
reference_candidate.training: 384 declared non-event observations from192 users, fit cutoff before calibration/test

calibration.method: split conformal upper-tail rank of maximum event scan score per original user
calibration.score: max contiguous fitted reduction sum/sqrt(window length), task window only
calibration.decision: evidence if finite-sample rank p<=alpha, otherwise inconclusive; measured outcomes never overwritten/filtered
calibration.assumption: calibration/test user maxima exchangeable; not guaranteed for shifts or actual deployments

data.generator: reuse existing independent fine-grid natural-load mechanism; new non-event/strong/weak/null response variants, truth evaluator-only
data.weak_types: half brief3/6min, half sustained; plateau.14q/.20q, participation retained; report actual true-positive denominators
data.timing: all model and calibration labels complete before validation/test notices; shifts are whole weeks preserving explicit calendar

fairness: same facts, declared device/task, old native CPOP/config unchanged; every path receives same independent calibration users, same score/alpha; reference improvement also supplied to CPOP
secondary: support by weak subtype and amplitude
adoption: no tuning or selection on main test; new API explicit optional; no promise all measures win; evidence calibration must not mask duration false positives or weak losses

continuous_after_reliability.process: original CPOP with new frozen reference, shared identically by all factor estimators; no filtered events
continuous_after_reliability.selection: non-oracle, user-separated nuisance prediction risk then user-held-out pseudo-outcome smoothing risk, frozen before test
continuous_after_reliability.baseline: existing Kennedy config defaults with n_boot199; same measured Y/X/D/users
continuous_after_reliability.caveat: validated configuration of shared mature estimator, not a new causal estimator; no deletion of L/U or forced monotonicity

exit: one frozen validation/main evaluation each phase; preserve failures and old source/results; no reports, B2/B3/B4, extra resources, ZIP/UI, installs or commits
